description: This file defines the GroupSyncable struct and related types and methods for managing group synchronization with channels and teams in Mattermost.

classes.name: GroupSyncable
classes.description: Represents a syncable group entity, such as a team or channel, with associated metadata and validation methods.

classes.name: GroupSyncableType
classes.description: String type defining whether the syncable is a 'Team' or 'Channel'.

classes.name: GroupSyncablePatch
classes.description: Struct for patching auto_add and scheme_admin properties of a GroupSyncable.

classes.name: UserTeamIDPair
classes.description: Pair of user ID and team ID.

classes.name: UserChannelIDPair
classes.description: Pair of user ID and channel ID.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of GroupSyncableType.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the GroupSyncable's fields for auditing.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the patch's fields for auditing.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to the GroupSyncable.

methods.name: NewGroupTeam
methods.description: Factory function to create a GroupSyncable for a team.

methods.name: NewGroupChannel
methods.description: Factory function to create a GroupSyncable for a channel.
